subject: Loading libraries to use inside map

messages.author: 5632195ef1c0e279
messages.subject: Loading libraries to use inside map
parts:
Hi,

According to the documentation you can load the libraries to be used
inside map in the map.setup phase. I want to try and use the foreach
package in my map. But I am getting the error:

Error in library(foreach) : there is no package called 'foreach'

on launching the job, and along with it also the Broken Pipe error.

My map.setup is:
map.setup <- expression (
library(foreach)
library(doMC)
)

Should I mention a path in the 'shared' argument in rhmr() pointing
to the location of the library installation? But the problem is that
won't be an HDFS path. So what should I do in order to load any
library that is to be used in a map or reduce?

BTW Has anyone tried using 'foreach' instead of 'for' in their map
expression:
for(i in 1: length(map.keys))

Would the map execution be quicker?

Regards,
Bharath
